            if (!v || !v.ShortName || map[v.ShortName]) return;
            currentVoices[v.ShortName] = v;
            map[v.ShortName] = {
                name: displayVoice(v),
                icon: s(v.Gender, "female").toLowerCase()
            };
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++) {
            var v = voices[i];
            if (v.Locale === locale) addVoice(v);
        }
        if (Object.keys(map).length <= 2 && locale !== DEFAULT_LOCALE) {
            currentVoices = {};
            map = {};
            for (var j = 0; j < voices.length; j++) {
                var zh = voices[j];
                if (zh.Locale === DEFAULT_LOCALE) addVoice(zh);
            }
        }
        if (!map[DEFAULT_VOICE]) addVoice(findVoice(DEFAULT_VOICE));
        return map;
    },

        if (!safeData("style", "")) setData("style", "auto");
        logInfo("[Clipchamp AugLoop/JRead] 插件加载完成，默认语言=" + DEFAULT_LOCALE + "，内置音色=" + voices.length + "，导演预设=" + DIRECTOR_PRESETS.length);
